{{Citation}}
A shipment of '''fusion shells''' was being transported aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Sidral II]]'' when it was [[Capture of the Sidral II|captured]] by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Tuz]]. Tuz delivered the stolen fusion cells to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].
